meta.title: eDecont.ro — AI Receipt Scanning & Expense Management | Geny Systems
meta.description: Automate receipt processing with AI-powered OCR. eDecont.ro by Geny Systems helps Romanian businesses scan receipts, manage expenses, and stay ANAF-compliant — all in one platform.

hero.subtitle: Scan receipts with AI, automate expense workflows, and stay compliant with ANAF. Built for Romanian businesses that want to spend less time on paperwork.

items.title: AI-Powered OCR
items.description: Snap a photo of any receipt. Our Vision AI extracts vendor, amounts, VAT, and line items automatically — with confidence scoring for every field.

items.title: Expense Management
items.description: Submit, review, and approve expenses with customizable multi-level approval workflows. Track status from draft to approved.

items.title: Multi-Fund Allocation
items.description: Split expenses across cost centers and funds with an intelligent rules engine. Automate allocation by category, vendor, or amount.

items.title: ANAF Integration
items.description: Automatic CUI lookup and validation against the Romanian tax authority database. Verify vendor status, VAT registration, and company details.

items.title: AI Chat Assistant
items.description: Ask questions about your expense data in natural language. Get instant insights, summaries, and analysis — in English or Romanian.

items.title: Reports & Export
items.description: Generate AI-summarized financial reports. Export to Saga XML, QuickBooks IIF, Excel, and CSV for seamless accounting integration.
